name: mill hearth
description: A soot-black hearth built into the mill wall. The fire inside has not needed fuel in seven nights.

state_descriptions.lit: A soot-black hearth. The fire inside burns without fuel.
state_descriptions.doused: The hearth is cold, but the stones are still warm to the touch.

name: millstone
description: A cracked millstone half-turned in its bed. Ash fills the grooves like grey flour.

name: grain bin
description: A timber bin of blackened grain. Something has been nesting in it.

name: notice board
description: A board of scorched notices: missing carts, a reward for the miller, and a warning about the ash path.

name: ash shrine
description: A roadside shrine of stacked bricks and cold cinders, its painted face worn away.

name: ember altar
description: A block of fire-blackened brick beneath a furnace mouth. The air above it shimmers.

state_descriptions.dormant: The altar is quiet, but the brick is hot enough to sting.
state_descriptions.awake: The altar glows from within, and the furnace mouth breathes.

name: charred chest
description: An iron-bound chest, scorched but intact, half-buried in ash.

content.name: Mill Ledger
content.description: A soot-stained ledger naming the mill's debts and the Covenant's friends

content.name: Ember Seal
content.description: A heavy iron seal warm to the touch, stamped with a furnace sigil

content.name: Ashglass Tonic
content.description: A smoky tonic that clears the lungs and restores health
